notes.notes: [p]Hello, I'm posting this message to inform everyone that soon, screenshots, and perhaps even some early gameplay, will be revealed, showcasing a Paladin-class character fighting reptilian creatures and more in the Forest of Magusse.[/p][p]But above all, I want to address the remarks from impatient players. Yes, the game [i]will[/i] be released in the year 2096. It’s not an MMORPG. It’s something entirely new: a unique genre created by someone with an extremely high intellectual potential. As an artist, this is my life’s work, my world, my heart. And yes, I will die before it's finished, just as you will die without ever playing it. But my son, and then my grandson, will continue developing this colossal project that will change the face of gaming. And your grandchildren will play it, not you, but your descendants.[/p][p]Still, out of mercy, I’m considering setting up a support system for fans. Possibly with in-game rewards such as having your name in the game’s credits. And yes, with more funding, the release date could be moved forward by 20 to 30 years, or more, depending on the level of support.[/p][p]That said, understand this: I don’t need anyone. I am at peace knowing that my grandson will finish my masterpiece. This offer is for you, not for me. I’ll simply wait to see if enough people recognize the value of something truly incredible and decide to support it. No promises, no obligations.[/p][p]We’ll see.[/p]
